title: Killer Single Dad
description: An expectant mother befriends a good Samaritan, unaware of his keen interest in her unborn baby.

title: Killing Daddy
description: A bitter woman (Elizabeth Gillies) hatches a vengeful scheme against her father, stepmother and sister.

title: Killing Mommy
description: A young woman (Yvonne Zima) must prevent her unstable twin sister from murdering their mother (Claire Rankin).

title: Cellmate Secrets
description:
S01 E01 — Casey Anthony
In 2008, Casey Anthony was charged with first degree murder for the disappearance of her daughter, Caylee. In new interviews, Robyn Adams shares how Casey lured her into a friendship, and Silvia Hernandez's life was ruined because of the two women.

title: Murder at the Hotel
description: Stranded at a hotel during a snowstorm, a woman runs into her high school sweetheart, sparking tension as her husband and daughter both disappear. Unsure who to trust, she must navigate a night of secrets, danger, and her own past to save her family.

title: My Father's Murder in Greece
description: George takes his daughter, Allie, on a celebratory trip to Greece to discover her familial roots. However, when George is murdered, Allie must uncover long-kept family secrets if she's going to bring the killer to justice.

title: Vanished in Yosemite
description: While vacationing in Yosemite, sisters Katrina and Jennifer meet the perfect guy. Katrina is certain she has met Mr. Right. When Katrina goes missing deep in the Yosemite wilderness, Jennifer suspects kidnapping and sets out to rescue her sister.
